'''Kristian Heugh''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 1st at [[January 2000 Greensboro tournament]] on 16 January 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Ops]], according to Leonard Mitchell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d190">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-19-greensboro-north-carolina-01-16-00d190/ greensboro-north-carolina-01-16-00], DeckTech (Leonard "Master Yoda" Mitchell, 19 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-19-greensboro-north-carolina-01-16-00d190/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
